messages:
michele: Repro in CI: when sampleapp prefetch window=3 we spike and get a burst of 429s. Happens more when token refresh and prefetch overlap. Noticed Retry-After header sometimes present, sometimes missing.

neil: logs?

michele: snippet:

```
prefetch enqueue cursor=cur1
request GET /v1/pages?cursor=cur1
server 429 Retry-After=2
retry scheduled after 2s
request GET /v1/pages?cursor=cur2
server 429 (no Retry-After)
client backoff jitter
```

tara: two quick asks: 1) SDK should honor Retry-After when present; 2) when header missing, fall back to an adaptive smoothing backoff (not full exp backoff) and limit concurrent prefetches based on in-flight retries.

neil: agree. For parity: Go SDK is strict server-first, Python uses small local smoothing. We should standardize and default to server-first with an opt-in `paginator.rateStrategy = "client-adaptive"` for migration.

michele: also want visible metrics in Console: `client.prefetch_inflight` and `client.429_rate` so users see why onboarding hits quota.

tara: plan: neil opens PR (header parsing + fallback algorithm), I'll update sampleapp to cap concurrent prefetches and emit metrics, add e2e that simulates missing Retry-After.

ci-bot: sampleapp CI job #6221 queued

michele: thanks — keeping thread to track PR and tests.
